newsitem.title: UK: DMG appoints new head of credit trading in Europe.
newsitem.headline: DMG appoints new head of credit trading in Europe.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has appointed Neal Neilinger as head of credit trading in Europe, a spokesman for the bank said on Tuesday.
Neilinger, who joins from Lehman Brothers, will be responsible for all of Europe except Germany.

"His responsibilities will include all non-Deutsche mark Eurobond market making, but most importantly asset swap and FRN trading, including the development of DMG's European loan trading and high yield business," the DMG spokesperson said.
Neilinger will report to DMG's head of European fixed income trading David Campbell.
